name: dsh-memory-db
description: DeepSeek Harness static plugin: per-project memory database (collect/classify/inject/admin page). Redacts secret tokens (github_pat_/ghp_/sk-/AKIA/xox*) before storing, injecting and persisting; multi-instance aware (admin URL follows the running webServer port, debug.log lines carry an instance tag). Uses dsh session-format v4 producer-owned source kinds (kind: plugin:memory-db); budget uses real LLM usage tokens; compacts history first when room for injection is insufficient. Compatible with dsh 0.1.x (settings API fallback) and 0.2.x (snapshotEvents).
